claim: OpenAIEmbeddings raises RuntimeError on all failure paths incl. degenerate provider responses (empty data / short batch data / zero-length vector element); never leaks IndexError/ValueError nor returns a short list for non-empty input.
RAGPipeline degrades an empty-choices ChatCompletion to answer="" (same path as null content) instead of IndexError -> 500.
StreamingRAGService skips choices=[] chunks and still emits the is_done completion chunk (with sources) on clean loop end even when the provider never sends a usage-only chunk.
StreamingRAGPipeline skips a choices=[] streaming chunk and still emits later content plus the done=true completion marker without an error result.
app.main imports and mounts the documents router under the /api/v1 prefix, making the document API routes reachable by the application.
